name: Heima
source:
A young thief who only steals swords and leaves three leaves behind as his calling card, the mark of the gentleman thief Sakaidori. Sarcastic, sharp, has a photographic memory, and keeps telling himself not to get involved.

[spoiler]He and his older sister were sold to the Rokumeirou brothel as kids. He became a thief to find the sword that killed her.[/spoiler]
